judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated on the one-dimensional Euclidean set I, with a>1 for the zero-measure implication and 0<s<1 for the infinite-measure implication; both exponents are positive. The interval-length and countable-subadditivity facts apply to measurable bounded open J_i, without requiring the original V_i to be measurable. The reviewed power and series facts have the required signs and countable indices. No E/M applications occur.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
